code:
az storage account update \
  --name ltvstorage01 \
  --resource-group rg-storage-lab \
  --sku Standard_GRS

code:
az storage account management-policy create \
  --account-name ltvstorage01 \
  --policy '{"rules":[{"name":"tier-and-expire-backups",
  "type":"Lifecycle","definition":{...}}]}'
caption: Cool after 7 days, Archive after 90, deleted after a year — automatically.
